title: Robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='38' ry='10' fill='#1b3a5c'/>
  <!-- main body (disc) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='36' ry='14' fill='#4a90d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='36' ry='14' fill='#6fb3f0'/>
  <!-- top face plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#a8d4ff'/>
  <!-- bumper ring highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='35' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#2f6cb0' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- sensor bump / lidar tower -->
  <rect x='44' y='36' width='12' height='12' rx='4' fill='#3a7ac2'/>
  <rect x='44' y='36' width='12' height='6' rx='4' fill='#5f9fdf'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='41' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- control button on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ff8fc7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#ffe0f0'/>
  <!-- small side buttons -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='2' fill='#7ee0a8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='2' fill='#7ee0a8'/>
  <!-- front display strip -->
  <rect x='30' y='63' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#123a60'/>
  <rect x='33' y='65' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#7ee0a8'/>
  <rect x='45' y='65' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='57' y='65' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ff8fc7'/>
  <!-- side brushes -->
  <g fill='#ffe08a'>
    <rect x='10' y='63' width='2' height='10' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='14' y='62' width='2' height='10' rx='1' transform='rotate(20 15 67)'/>
    <rect x='88' y='63' width='2' height='10' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='84' y='62' width='2' height='10' rx='1' transform='rotate(-20 85 67)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little wheels -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='70' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='70' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
</svg>
